message.content:
The completion claim is **partially supported**. 

**Established**: The script demonstrates real rendering (OpenGL context initialized), gameplay elements (world generation, keyboard input), and performance metrics (60 FPS). The verification confirms these exact strings exist in the file.

**Unverified**: Actual gameplay functionality, true hardware acceleration (Mesa llvmpipe is software rasterization), and whether this constitutes "real" gameplay beyond the basic system initialization. The script only shows initialization messages, not actual game interaction or mechanics.
